title: Same Project has 6 times more FPS when it has been set up completely new
body:
### Tested versions

official mono stable 4.4.1
official mono stable 4.5
mono custom 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900KF (32 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a 2D Open World Game with chunk systems and custom autotiling etc.

I noticed over the last days that the FPS decreased a alot but I have not even changed systems which are performance heavy. I even cached some more data but only some configs.

My performance was at 80 Fps and I thought there is something wrong.. So I tested different Godot versions.

The stable Godot version (4.4.1 and 4.5) all had the same performance about 80 FPS.

A custom 4.4.1 version had about 155 FPS. But I did not change anything. Only added one additional module (GodotSteam).

80 FPS - Version 4.5 and 4.4.1 stable

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/977f2c96-2dbf-4c05-9e6f-7870a83598e5


155 FPS - Version 4.4.1 custom incl. GodotSteam

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bab1a01b-8a0b-4598-8ad7-d7e8a440b1c6

I also deleted all Godot caches in appdata and also the .godot folder but that did nothing. Performance was the same.


But this is not the end. I was curious what would happen when I setup a fresh project and copy all resources into the new one.

The result is about **450 - 550 FPS** just by setting up a new project and copy everything into it. **Nothing else changed.** 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3fb2eea-f3f2-4781-ae3d-3aae38ae8542

### Steps to reproduce

Unfortunately I do not know how to exactly reproduce it. 

1. Copy all assets to the new project
2. Create new C# project file
3. run the project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I tried to make an MRP but I was not able to reproduce it. I guess it is a caching issue in my project maybe?

If needed I can submit my project per DM or similar but I would rather not publish it here as I want to publish the game.

Edit: Attached my project stripped down to the bare minimum that it is still working but reproduces the issue
[Performance Fast.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22571078/Performance.Fast.zip)
[PerformanceSlow (2).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22571077/PerformanceSlow.2.zip)
